decision.observation: Gear has shifted to 1 and the car reads 3 mph while still beside the pine trunk, red X lit. The tarmac with marker posts and puddles runs up the screen to the right of the car, banners beyond it.
decision.hypothesis: Forward motion worked here, unlike the reverse holds which barely moved the car. Continued throttle with right steer should carry it forward-right onto the tarmac and clear the red X.
decision.memory: W+D freed the car from the stall that repeated reverse-steers could not break. The drivable tarmac is up-screen and to the right of the car's position.
